主要内容: On June 13, 2012, MEDALLION FINANCIAL CORP shareholders approved several corporate actions. The Board of Directors elected Stanley Kreitman, Frederick A. Menowitz, and David L. Rudick as Class I Directors. Shareholders ratified the appointment of WeiserMazars LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm. They also approved a non-binding advisory resolution to approve executive compensation and voted in favor of conducting advisory votes every year on executive compensation frequency.
